features.name: Create a new password database
steps: Tap "create a new password database" on the launch page
Choose the save location and file name for the .kdbx
Enter "assign master key"
A master password can be enabled by entering the same password twice
A key file can be enabled at the same time, and one can be generated/selected
Depending on the current screen, a hardware key can optionally be configured
After confirming, the database file is actually created
Automatically enter the new database
The root group is empty and the database can be edited normally. After closing and re-selecting that .kdbx, it must be opened with the credential combination created for it.
features.expected: The root group is empty and the database can be edited normally. After closing and re-selecting that .kdbx, it must be opened with the credential combination created for it.

features.name: Open, unlock, and re-lock the password database
steps: Tap "open an existing password database" or choose a recent database on the launch page
Select the .kdbx
The unlock page shows password, key-file, hardware-key, and other inputs according to the database's requirements
Unlock the database with the correct credentials
Wrong credentials cannot enter
Tap the lock icon in the UI or "lock" in the sidebar
The current database content disappears and it returns to the locked state
Access is restored only after providing the correct credentials again. If the app setting for "delete password" is enabled, the entered password should be cleared after one failed attempt.
features.expected: Access is restored only after providing the correct credentials again. If the app setting for "delete password" is enabled, the entered password should be cleared after one failed attempt.

features.name: Change the master key and database security parameters
steps: The database is unlocked
Enter "database settings
Master key"
Use "change master key"
Change the password and/or key-file combination
Save the database
Lock

The old credential combination can no longer unlock while the new one can. Entering "security settings" should correctly display the encryption algorithm and key-derivation parameters actually used by the current database; the KDBX3.1 database in the screenshot shows Rijndael/AES with AES KDF and a transformation-rounds parameter.
features.expected: The old credential combination can no longer unlock while the new one can. Entering "security settings" should correctly display the encryption algorithm and key-derivation parameters actually used by the current database; the KDBX3.1 database in the screenshot shows Rijndael/AES with AES KDF and a transformation-rounds parameter.

features.name: Database save, merge, reload, and save-as-copy
steps: Modify entries in the database
Use "Save data" to write the current in-memory state back to the current URI
Use "Save a copy to..." to choose another file location and produce an independent .kdbx copy
When the current data differs from the external version in the file, use "merge data" to keep and merge the changes
"Reload data" abandons the current in-memory state and re-reads the version in the file. Each command must have distinct semantics rather than all being equivalent to an ordinary refresh.
features.expected: "Reload data" abandons the current in-memory state and re-reads the version in the file. Each command must have distinct semantics rather than all being equivalent to an ordinary refresh.

features.name: Group-tree creation and hierarchical navigation
steps: Tap "+" in the database root
Choose "add group"
Enter the group name and notes
The expiry time, search behavior, and tags can be configured
Save
A group is added in the root and shows its entry count
After entering a group the breadcrumb path at the top changes
Subgroups or entries can be created inside a group
The hierarchy is preserved when returning to the parent. After changing the group name the path and list update in sync.
features.expected: The hierarchy is preserved when returning to the parent. After changing the group name the path and list update in sync.

features.name: Full CRUD for standard password entries
steps: Tap "add entry"
Use the "Standard" template
Fill in the title, username, password, URL, expiry time, notes, and tags
Save
The entry appears in the current group
Show summaries such as the title, username, and tags according to the appearance settings
Open the entry again and modify a field
The list reflects the change immediately after saving
After locking and unlocking the database again the modification still exists
After deleting an entry it is removed from the normal grouping.
features.expected: After deleting an entry it is removed from the normal grouping.

features.name: Dynamic entry templates
steps: Switch the entry type at the top of the new-entry screen
Verify at least the types shown in the screenshot such as "standard, email, Wi-Fi, note, ID card, debit/credit card, bank, and crypto wallet"
Different types use different icons and field structures
Fill in data using a template and save
Reopening still uses the same template and keeps the corresponding fields. Template behavior is part of the data model rather than merely changing the title text or icon.
features.expected: Reopening still uses the same template and keeps the corresponding fields. Template behavior is part of the data model rather than merely changing the title text or icon.

features.name: Password display, strength feedback, and password generation
steps: Enter the password in the entry editor
The password is hidden by default
Tap the eye button to toggle between plain text and hidden
The strength/entropy indicator changes in sync when the password changes
Tap the random-generate entry to generate a new password
The generated result is genuinely written into the password field
After saving and reopening it is still that value. The strength number in the UI must not be updated without changing the real password.
features.expected: After saving and reopening it is still that value. The strength number in the UI must not be updated without changing the real password.

features.name: Tag management and cross-object persistence
steps: Edit the entry
Enter a new tag in the tag field and confirm
Tags are displayed as chips
The tag can be removed
After saving, the list shows tags according to the "show tags" setting
Tags can also be associated when creating/editing groups
The same tag can be reused by several objects
The tag relationships are preserved after sorting, locking, and reopening the database.
features.expected: The tag relationships are preserved after sorting, locking, and reopening the database.

features.name: Custom fields and protected fields
steps: Edit the entry
Add a custom field
Enter the field name and value
The "protect" state can be toggled
After confirming, the field joins the entry
Ordinary fields are shown as plain text while protected fields follow the sensitive-field hide/show rules
Modify fields, delete fields, then save
Re-entering the entry still preserves the field order, names, values, and protection attributes.
features.expected: Re-entering the entry still preserves the field order, names, values, and protection attributes.

features.name: TOTP / OTP configuration and dynamic tokens
steps: Open an entry
Enter the OTP settings
Select TOTP and RFC6238
Enter the OTP secret
Choose the algorithm, e.g. SHA1 as in the screenshot
Set the period to 30 seconds and the digit count to 6
Save
The entry generates the current OTP
The token changes automatically after the time window ends
If "show OTP token" is enabled the list can also display the corresponding state
The OTP can be copied/used for filling. The same secret and time parameters should produce deterministically identical results.
features.expected: The OTP can be copied/used for filling. The same secret and time parameters should produce deterministically identical results.

features.name: Entry attachment management
steps: Edit the entry
Tap the attachment
Supports the entries shown in the screenshot: "take a photo / record an audio note / choose from the album / pick from storage"
After choosing the file the binary data is genuinely written into the entry
The page shows the attachment's file name, size, and compression state, e.g. the MP4 and Gzip compression in the screenshot
Save the entry
The attachment still exists after reopening
After deleting an attachment it is removed from the entry and the final database.
features.expected: After deleting an attachment it is removed from the entry and the final database.

features.name: Entry search and quick location
steps: Create several entries in the database with different titles, usernames, URLs, or tags
Tap search
Enter a keyword
The list dynamically narrows to matching items

Clearing the search restores the full list. With "quick search" in the app settings enabled, entering an opened database goes directly into the search state; with "subdomain search" enabled, domain lookup related to URL/form matching should follow that toggle.
features.expected: Clearing the search restores the full list. With "quick search" in the app settings enabled, entering an opened database goes directly into the search state; with "subdomain search" enabled, domain lookup related to URL/form matching should follow that toggle.

features.name: Sorting and grouping display rules
steps: Create several entries with different titles, usernames, and time properties plus at least one group
Open sorting
Select "natural order, title, username, creation time, modification time, access time" respectively
The list order changes by the selected field
"Bottom first" changes the ascending/descending direction
"Groups first" determines the relative area of groups and ordinary entries
The sort state is preserved after closing the settings and re-entering the list.
features.expected: The sort state is preserved after closing the settings and re-entering the list.

features.name: Recycle bin and deletion recovery
steps: Enable "recycle bin usage" in the database settings
Delete an entry or group
The object should not physically disappear from the database but should enter the configured recycle-bin group
Invisible from the normal list
Deleted objects can be identified in the recycle bin and restored or permanently deleted
After restoring, the original content reappears. After disabling the recycle-bin behavior, the deletion semantics should change according to the setting.
features.expected: After restoring, the original content reappears. After disabling the recycle-bin behavior, the deletion semantics should change according to the setting.

features.name: Entry version history
steps: Enable database entry history
Modify the password, username, or notes of the same entry repeatedly and save several times
Entries should form version history
Old version content can be viewed
After restoring a history version the current entry returns to that state
Deleting a history record should not delete the current entry. Limits such as "maximum count" in the database settings should control the history retention size.
features.expected: Deleting a history record should not delete the current entry. Limits such as "maximum count" in the database settings should control the history retention size.

features.name: Device unlock / biometric quick unlock
steps: Enter "device unlock"
Enable biometric or device-credential unlock
Establish a device-side quick-unlock relationship for the current database
Lock the database
When re-entering, access can be restored via Android biometrics/device credentials without fully re-entering the master password
A master-key fallback path should still exist
After "delete encryption key" the previously established device-unlock relationship becomes invalid.
features.expected: After "delete encryption key" the previously established device-unlock relationship becomes invalid.

features.name: Autofill, device keyboard, and secure copy
steps: Enable the credential provider/autofill or the device keyboard under "form filling"
The database contains entries matching the target app/URL
Trigger a search in the login form and select an entry
The username and password are filled into the corresponding fields; entries with OTP configured can provide OTP fill/copy
The subdomain-search toggle affects URL matching
The clipboard timeout setting determines how long copied content is retained
The "clipboard trust settings" control whether passwords and protected fields may be copied.
features.expected: The "clipboard trust settings" control whether passwords and protected fields may be copied.

features.name: Appearance, database properties, and display policy
steps: Switch the app theme/brightness, icon pack, and entry color under "Appearance"

The list updates immediately while the database data does not change; toggle in turn "hide expired entries, hide templates, show username, show entry count, recursive entry count, show tags, show OTP, show UUID, list item size, field font", etc.

The list information is shown/hidden according to the settings. Entering the database settings allows changing the database name, description, default username, and color, and viewing properties such as the version, compression method, template groups, and history limits; after saving and reopening the database they are preserved.
features.expected: The list information is shown/hidden according to the settings. Entering the database settings allows changing the database name, description, default username, and color, and viewing properties such as the version, compression method, template groups, and history limits; after saving and reopening the database they are preserved.
